69cc2b207cbf66a974bbfe59 Description: Mercenary, come, I have something for you. There was a firefight not too long ago at one of the warehouse buildings in the Polikhim area, near the river. The locals sheltered there must have left in a hurry and most of what they had is still there. When people leave like that, they don't evaluate what they're abandoning. Check the area and see if you can find anything useful.
69cc2b2a7a9440c554bbfe5a: Find something of value at the location
69cc2b207cbf66a974bbfe59 SuccessMessageT: Drone parts? Interesting. I'll see if anything can be done. Check back later.
69cd0395d71356193f24354d Description: I went through what you brought me. Most of it held up better than expected, enough even to put something together. Point is, it works - but not like this. Without proper components its essentially only a paperweight, and as you can imagine, these components are not easy to find. The only person that can provide these things is Skier, but he does not work for free. I need something to bargain with. Bring me some cash, and I'll take care of it.
69cd0395d71356193f24354d SuccessMessageT: You got the money? Good. Leave it here. I'll handle the rest. Skier will contact you.
69cd51d2101b8a503d243562 Description:
So Skier wanted you to do something in trade for sending over the components? This is hardly unusual. Anyway, the drones are now complete. All that remains is to test them out. I've also included a few basic payloads, just enough to make the tests meaningful.

Here, take a couple of them, on me. Put them to good use. If you lose them, Skier has more parts coming in.
69cd521ede2c8a3adf243563: Hit any target using an FPV drone on Woods
69cd51d2101b8a503d243562 SuccessMessageT: Well, back already? How did it go? Tell me everything.
69cbe2c1e4157bab57f2911c Description:
You've been making some noise lately, and people are starting to notice. This means you're capable, and more importantly, useful.

I've got a situation that needs handling. I lost a shipment and a few people along with it. Locals hit the convoy and picked everything clean, which you can assume, is bad for business.

It'd be a waste to lose an operator such as yourself, so take a different approach. I recently got my hands on a batch of new "birds" from Sergey and I figured its time they earn their keep. Go deal with it.
69cbe3274aa75df0c5f29120: Eliminate Scavs using an FPV drone
69cbe2c1e4157bab57f2911c SuccessMessageT: Looks like the toys were worth the money after all. Come get your reward.
69cd208ba9ce137d72243552 Description:
Sergey got in touch, handed me some cash and a shopping list. Motherboards, check. Batteries, check. Various other toys, check. Something is missing though. Ah-haa! A favor! Did you really think old Skier here would risk his neck for a couple of dollars?

Listen, the job is simple. A group of scavengers stole a valuable package from my guys and stashed it somewhere in the Customs area, word is they were camped out in the red warehouse. Recover the package and teach them a lesson, yeah?
69cd20a248fddb8c14243554: Find the stolen package on Customs
69cd20941966973140243553: Eliminate Scavs with headshots on Customs
69cd208ba9ce137d72243552 SuccessMessageT: Hahaha! To hell with those guys! You don't mess with Skier! You found it? Great, put it over there. Go talk to Mechanic, the shipment is on its way.
